They lock in their favorite spread picks, totals, and weekly parlays, featuring a strong position on the Chargers as their Brass Balls selection.",

      "text": "Welcome to Sharp or Square, we are brought to you by Polymarket and we are part of the Volume Podcast Network. I am Chad Millman, joined as always by my BFF, my companion, Simon Hunter. We kick off Week 3 discussing Caleb Williams' Wolverine-like recovery from his hamstring injury, making him potentially ready for Monday night, and Jackson Dart's knee injury status."
    },
    {
      "start": 150.0,
      "end": 340.0,
      "speaker": "Simon Hunter",
      "text": "The Giants are also in focus, with Eli Manning's durability records being discussed alongside trade rumors for J.J. McCarthy or Mac Jones to salvage their season after a rough start. The books have already adjusted their division odds significantly."
    },
    {
      "start": 340.0,
      "end": 510.0,
      "speaker": "Chad Millman",
      "text": "Don't forget to sign up for our free $25,000 Pick 'Em Contest at sharporsquare.thevolume.com. We drop everyone's lowest weekly score after Week 5, so you still have a great chance to compete and win cash prizes."
    },
    {
      "start": 510.0,
      "end": 620.0,
      "speaker": "Simon Hunter",
      "text": "Let's dive into Sharp Calls. The Atlanta game is highly discussed with Penix returning from injury. Professionally, there is big money coming in on Atlanta, moving the line down to 4.5. Also, the Florida vs. Ole Miss college matchup has all the sharp money backing Florida."
    },
    {
      "start": 620.0,
      "end": 785.0,
      "speaker": "Chad Millman",
      "text": "Moving to Patriots at Jaguars, JAX is currently a 3-point favorite, though it opened at 2.5. This was my choice, and despite JAX's defensive questions against New England's heavily simplified offense without AJ Brown, I still like JAX at 2.5."
    },
    {
      "start": 785.0,
      "end": 900.0,
      "speaker": "Simon Hunter",
      "text": "We also have Titans at Giants. With the line moving from 3.5 to 2.5, I can't recommend Tennessee anymore. Jameis Winston is historically poor as a favorite, and the value is completely gone at this current number."
    },
    {
      "start": 900.0,
      "end": 1095.0,
      "speaker": "Simon Hunter",
      "text": "For Seahawks at Commanders, Seattle is a solid play. Mike Macdonald has been an absolute machine against the spread as a favorite, especially on the road. Mariota's deep-ball inconsistency against this secondary is going to put Washington in a very tough spot."
    },
    {
      "start": 1095.0,
      "end": 1340.0,
      "speaker": "Simon Hunter",
      "text": "Our Brass Balls play of the week has to be the Los Angeles Chargers +7.5 against the Bills. Herbert as a big underdog is an elite cover artist. Plus, Harbaugh has a phenomenal track record when playing with a rest disadvantage against highly-rated teams."
    },
    {
      "start": 1340.0,
      "end": 1430.0,
      "speaker": "Chad Millman",
      "text": "In Jets at Lions, the professionals are taking Jets +6.5. Geno Smith's ability to keep pace with Jared Goff is the key question, but Detroit's defense is shaky enough that the Jets on the moneyline at +250 is worth a look."
    },
    {
      "start": 1430.0,
      "end": 1705.0,
      "speaker": "Chad Millman",
      "text": "The Panthers play the Browns. While Bryce Young and the Panthers are surprising road favorites, the Browns at +2.5 or +3 is the side to be on. We also have a fun Discord group prop on Deshaun Watson Anytime Touchdown at +330."
    },
    {
      "start": 1705.0,
      "end": 2085.0,
      "speaker": "Simon Hunter",
      "text": "Texans at Colts is a classic sharp play. Indy is a home divisional underdog at 0-2, and major books are already taking professional money, driving the Colts down to +1.5. C.J. Stroud has the stats, but Houston's run defense is highly exploitable."
    },
    {
      "start": 2085.0,
      "end": 2300.0,
      "speaker": "Simon Hunter",
      "text": "Vikings at Bucs has a massive coaching trend. Kevin O'Connell is 13-0 straight up as a road favorite when the total is under 45. Tampa Bay looked incredibly sloppy last week, making Minnesota a very solid favorite play."
    },
    {
      "start": 2300.0,
      "end": 2525.0,
      "speaker": "Simon Hunter",
      "text": "Cardinals at Niners is currently at 8.5. San Francisco is getting all the public tickets, but pros are taking Arizona. Marvin Harrison Jr. looks completely unmotivated and is catching heat for not blocking, but Jacoby Brissett can find a backdoor cover here."
    },
    {
      "start": 2525.0,
      "end": 2745.0,
      "speaker": "Chad Millman",
      "text": "Chiefs are 11-point favorites at the Dolphins. Andy Reid's tendency to stall out and play extremely conservative with a second-half lead makes Miami a great double-digit underdog home play."
    },
    {
      "start": 2745.0,
      "end": 3070.0,
      "speaker": "Simon Hunter",
      "text": "Raiders are visiting the Saints. New Orleans is down their best tackle against Maxx Crosby, and Kirk Cousins is finding supreme comfort in Kubiak's scheme. I love the Raiders at +3 or +3.5."
    },
    {
      "start": 3070.0,
      "end": 3240.0,
      "speaker": "Simon Hunter",
      "text": "Rams are at the Broncos. With Kupp and Puka injured, Denver's defense should limit the passing game, and Bo Nix has a solid opportunity to bounce back at home in the altitude."
    },
    {
      "start": 3240.0,
      "end": 3390.0,
      "speaker": "Chad Millman",
      "text": "Finally, Eagles at Bears is a stay-away for the contest. With Caleb Williams injured and Bagent in concussion protocol, Case Keenum likely gets the nod, but the fluctuating line makes it too volatile."
    },
    {
      "start": 3390.0,
      "end": 3822.0,
      "speaker": "Chad Millman",
      "text": "We wrap up by summarizing our Underdog Moneyline Parlay (Jets, Raiders, Colts, Browns, Broncos) and our Favorites Parlay (Seahawks, Chiefs, Jaguars, Ravens, Bengals), and lock in the Chiefs as our Survivor pick."
    }
  ],
